state.initial: 0,0 (IWRAM is zero-cleared by crt0 at 0x0800010c); no explicit seeding - VERIFIED no writes during boot logos
state.seeding: entropy comes only from the number of frames spent on the title/intro screens (0x08000c1c calls rng() every frame there); in gameplay the RNG is NOT advanced per frame, only on demand (VERIFIED: 120 idle frames in-map -> 0 calls). State is not saved to EEPROM (not part of the 0x164-byte party block) - INFERRED

chance.formula: chance(p) = 1 if (rng() & 0xffff) < p else 0   -> probability p/65536

verified: Damage formula predictions using this RNG matched the emulator 14/14 hits; level-up prediction matched (it_lvl.py).
